name: agent-chain-doctor
description: Requires bash 3.2+ and Unix tools on the machine running the scheduler. Setup downloads a commit-pinned script from GitHub to ~/.local/bin and verifies its SHA-256; diagnosis reads local scheduler/state files without network or writes. No account, key or fee. Cannot inspect hosted schedulers; findings cover 30 known checks, not a health guarantee.
author: elfovo
permission_note: Use according to upstream license terms and attribution requirements.
